MANIFEST.description: This suite's own indicator set: what each thing ExecVis emits means, and the worked example for a project writing its own

note: What this suite's own output means. Run the recorder over a machine running execviz and read the capture through this: `execviz profile --records capture.ndjson --profile execviz.profile.json`. Keep each summary; they are small enough that one per week for a year is a few hundred kilobytes, and any two can be compared with `--baseline`. Meanings are this project's own: `fault` exits 1 so CI can gate on it, `warning` is worth reading, `informational` is context.

indicators.label: floor_offset_table_wrong
indicators.note: The register table does not describe this kernel. Records produced with a wrong table are not trustworthy. Resolve this before reading anything else in the capture.

indicators.label: floor_offset_table_unproved
indicators.note: The probe was not seen. This is not a disproof; the table is uncertified on this machine.

indicators.label: floor_offset_table_proved
indicators.note: The recorder performed a known write and the record agreed on descriptor, length and syscall number.

indicators.label: floor_attached
indicators.note: The recorder loaded and attached. Absent across a whole capture, nothing was being recorded.

indicators.label: floor_prog_load_failed
indicators.note: The verifier refused the program. The capture is empty; the reason follows in the verifier log.

indicators.label: floor_attach_failed
indicators.note: The tracepoint could not be opened, usually a missing capability or a locked-down kernel.

indicators.label: floor_permission_denied
indicators.note: CAP_BPF and CAP_PERFMON are required, or root. The recorder prints the exact setcap line when this happens.

indicators.label: floor_ring_buffer_refused
indicators.note: The kernel is below 5.8 or the BPF syscall is unavailable. Nothing can be captured on this machine.

indicators.label: floor_wrong_architecture
indicators.note: The binary's register table is for another architecture. The recorder refuses to run.

indicators.label: recorder_self_overhead_suppressed
indicators.note: The recorder's own observation calls, excluded from the capture. A large number is normal. Zero on a busy machine indicates the self-exemption is not matching this architecture's syscall numbers.

indicators.label: capture_truncated_payload
indicators.note: A payload longer than the bounded slice. The true byte count is still recorded.

indicators.label: collector_refused_span
indicators.note: The collector refused spans and said why. Every adapter reads this reply. A rising count indicates an adapter producing spans the contract does not allow.

indicators.label: collector_not_accepting_writes
indicators.note: The instance is answering requests and keeping nothing. The instance answers requests and keeps nothing.

indicators.label: store_write_failed
indicators.note: The store could not persist. Usually a full disk. Writes degrade to refusals rather than corruption.

indicators.label: capture_not_conformant
indicators.note: An adapter produced spans the conformance checker rejects. The graph is still readable. The adapter is not honouring the contract.

indicators.label: witness_found_a_lie
indicators.note: A span claimed work the machine did not do. Instrumentation reported work that did not happen.

indicators.label: witness_coverage_gap
indicators.note: Work no span accounts for. The trace is incomplete here rather than wrong, and this says where.

indicators.label: detect_stuck_span
indicators.note: A span that started and never finished while the capture continued past it.

indicators.label: detect_orphaned_span
indicators.note: A span whose parent is absent. The parent was evicted, or the carrier did not travel.

indicators.label: rules_file_unknown_predicate
indicators.note: A rules file with a typo matches nothing. This exits 2 rather than passing.

indicators.label: stress_nothing_intercepted
indicators.note: The program never made the calls the plan stops at. The run demonstrated nothing.

indicators.label: stress_could_not_inject
indicators.note: A fault that could not be carried out. Counted separately from injected faults.

indicators.label: clock_disagreement
indicators.note: Hosts in one capture are not reading the same clock. Drift and a wrong clock are different diagnoses.

indicators.label: capture_incomplete
indicators.note: Eviction discarded a trace holding an error or an open span.

indicators.label: oversized_trace_dropped
indicators.note: One trace larger than the whole buffer. Either the buffer is too small or the trace is pathological.

indicators.label: error_stream_output
indicators.note: Anything the machine wrote to a standard error stream, whoever wrote it.

indicators.label: inbound_payload
indicators.note: Bytes that arrived from outside, captured at syscall exit. Absent on a service that serves requests, the read side is not working.

indicators.label: binary_payload
indicators.note: Output that is not text, recorded as hex.

indicators.label: signal_payload
indicators.note: A one or two byte poke, typically an eventfd wake. Recorded rather than filtered out.
